definitions.proposal: Separate Success, Reject, FuelExhausted and HostFault rather than equating failure with logical falsity.
Seven-component logical Gamma plus explicit lock/call-local concurrent machine state; retains original typed Plan as distinct model.
Finite ranked DAG representation and graph-only typed chains. Ordinary equivalence with finite acyclicity supplied; not an adopted source definition.

interface_changes.change: Refuse JSON output container depth >100 before success; decoder gate unchanged; scalar-at-depth-100 remains accepted.
Capture a bounded flat tuple before validation and lock wait; commit that same validated tuple.

Require each native module row to be an exact two-element list/tuple before unpacking. This also refuses previously tolerated arbitrary two-item iterable rows; that domain restriction requires later explicit review.
